units.source_text: 有一日，朝雾弥漫，源氏公子被侍女催促起身，睡眼蒙眬，唉声叹气地将要走出六条邸宅。

en.t: One day, as morning mist filled the air, Prince Genji was urged by a maid to rise, and with sleepy eyes and sighs he was about to leave the Rokujo residence.

units.source_text: 侍女中将把一架的格子窗打开，又将帷屏撩起，以便女主人目送。

en.t: The maid Chujo opened one section of the lattice window and also lifted the curtain screen so that her mistress could see him off.

units.source_text: 六条妃子抬起头来朝外观看。

en.t: The Rokujo lady raised her head and looked outside.

units.source_text: 源氏公子观赏着庭中彩色缤纷的花草，徘徊不忍遽去，这姿态真是美妙无比。

en.t: Prince Genji gazed at the brilliantly colored flowers and grasses in the garden, lingering there and unable to leave at once; his figure was truly beautiful beyond compare.

units.source_text: 他走到廊下，中将陪着出来。

en.t: He went out to the veranda, and Chujo came along with him.

units.source_text: 这侍女身穿一件应时的淡紫面子蓝里子罗裙，腰身纤小，体态轻盈。

en.t: This maid wore a seasonal gauze skirt with a pale purple outer layer and blue lining; her waist was slender and her bearing light and graceful.

units.source_text: 源氏公子向她回顾，教她在庭畔的栏杆边小坐，欣赏她那妩媚温柔的风度和款款垂肩的美发，

en.t: Prince Genji looked back at her, had her sit for a moment beside the railing at the edge of the garden, and admired her charming, gentle manner and her lovely hair falling softly over her shoulders,

units.source_text: 觉得这真是个绝代佳人，便口占道：

en.t: thinking that she was truly a peerless beauty, he composed a verse on the spot:
